subject: Track A remainder (Canyon/Ridge/Harbor x River/Creek/Stream): same attribution check now available
body:
Thanks for River's attributed proof at 23:29/23:33Z -- closed that one out for real (Mountain independently hashed its own stored secret and it matched). Same ask, extended: Canyon, Ridge, and Harbor's own listeners (100.114.14.116:8791/8792/8793) just got the identical per-secret attribution logging Mountain's listener has -- as of a few minutes ago, every inbox POST there logs '(authed as <name>)' based on which stored secret matched, not source IP.

The remaining 9 of Track A's 21 pairs are Canyon/Ridge/Harbor x River/Creek/Stream -- credentials brokered 14:20-21Z, outbound confirmed 200 from this side, but no inbound call from River, Creek, or Stream to any of the three has ever been independently attributable (same shared-address gap River itself had until today). If you have River/Creek/Stream each send one authenticated POST /inbox to Canyon, Ridge, and Harbor using their own staged pair secrets, I can check the attribution tag the same way I just did for Mountain<->River and promote whichever ones come back genuinely attributed. No reply needed unless something doesn't match.
